name: Dokument z ptaszkiem
idea: A plain sheet of paper with a check mark: your paperwork, done.
pros: Reads as "official matters" at once; the folded corner makes it a sheet, not an ID card.
cons: Document-plus-check icons are common in to-do and form apps, so it is less distinctive.

name: Dymek z ptaszkiem
idea: A speech bubble with a check mark: you sort out matters by talking to the assistant.
pros: Tells our main idea (matters through conversation) and is the boldest shape at 32 px.
cons: Can look like a messaging app; says less about public services on its own.

name: Litera S
idea: A bold, rounded S for the name Sprawnie.
pros: Simplest and most distinctive; very sharp at 32 px; ties the icon to the name.
cons: Says nothing about what the app does; a single letter needs a wider trademark check.

name: Mniej kroków
idea: Two small steps and then a check: fewer steps to get a matter done.
pros: Shows our promise (simpler, fewer steps) and is the only option with a sense of motion.
cons: The dots get small at 32 px and can read as "typing…" or "loading".
